# muxt does not look for an import cycle: a path parameter type declared in
# admin itself, not in the hub, makes the hub import admin and admin import the
# hub. muxt generate succeeds and the Go build reports the cycle.

muxt generate
! exec go build ./...
stderr 'import cycle'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- muxt.json --
{
	"route_paths": {},
	"package_defaults": {
		"use_receiver_type": "Server"
	},
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m/admin": [{}],
		"example.com/m/blog": [{}]
	}
}
-- admin/admin.go --
package admin

import (
	"html/template"
	"strconv"
)

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /user/{id} GetUser(id)").Parse(`<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>`))

// UserID is declared here, not in the hub.
type UserID int

func (id *UserID) UnmarshalText(text []byte) error {
	n, err := strconv.Atoi(string(text))
	*id = UserID(n)
	return err
}

func (id UserID) MarshalText() ([]byte, error) {
	return []byte(strconv.Itoa(int(id))), nil
}

type Server struct{}

func (Server) GetUser(id UserID) string { return "user" }
-- blog/blog.go --
package blog

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /article/{id} GetArticle(id)").Parse(`<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) GetArticle(id int) string { return "article" }
